why_it_exists: Concurrent baskets compete for the last available unit.
design_decisions: Reservations and event receipts commit together.
A per-store SQL identity fences every action.
known_limits: No purchasing authority or direct agent calls.

tool_descriptions.inventory.read: Read stock and reservations in this store.
tool_descriptions.inventory.reserve: Reserve available units atomically for a basket.
tool_descriptions.inventory.delay: Record a shipment delay without inventing stock.
tool_descriptions.inventory.receive: Receive the confirmed shipment into physical stock.
tool_descriptions.memory.read: Recall evidence inside the current run, role and order scope.
tool_descriptions.memory.write: Append a bounded memory observation with provenance.
tool_descriptions.queue.publish: Publish an allowed topic to a permitted recipient.
